translated_content: Hello.L would like to share my experience using XanhSM.L has been using the app for over 3 years and recently booked a car for 2 trips per week with a fairly close distance of less than 2km.I don't know if it's because it's so close so few drivers want to take the trip, but L often has his trip canceled.During the year, L booked more than a dozen trips, but half of the times they were canceled without prior notice, while L waited for the bus for more than 5 minutes.To be sure, L calls the driver first to see if he receives it, then L waits for the car. If he doesn't receive it, he changes it.What a pain!
